parts.text: Product photograph, one 250 ml round-shoulder clear glass bottle of orange juice with a polished metal cap, blank label area with no label, standing on a pale cool-grey matte surface. Single large soft window light from the left and slightly above; one long soft highlight down the bottle's left shoulder, one small reflection on the cap, soft shadow falling to the right. Warm orange liquid glowing where the light passes through; cool quiet background. Three-quarter view from slightly above showing the front, the shoulder and the top of the cap. Bottle placed right of centre with a small gap above and below it. Nothing else in frame. No text, no lettering, no logo, no numerals anywhere in the image.
